code.name: [[4,2,2]] error-detecting code
code.pauli_notation: Each character is a single-qubit Pauli (I, X, Y, Z) acting on the corresponding qubit. E.g. XIXI means X on qubit 0, I on qubit 1, X on qubit 2, I on qubit 3.

encoding_circuit.description: Prepares logical state |00>_L from initial state |0000>. Gates are listed in chronological order (first gate applied first).

noise_model.pauli_basis: The sum ranges over the 15 non-identity elements of {I,X,Y,Z}^{tensor 2} applied to the two noise qubits, embedded in the full 4-qubit Hilbert space via tensor product with identity on the remaining qubits.
noise_model.applied_after: each CNOT gate on the gate's control and target qubits

post_selection.description: Project onto the codespace: the joint +1 eigenspace of all stabilizer generators.
post_selection.projector_construction: For stabilizer generators S_1, S_2, ..., the codespace projector is Pi = product_i (I + S_i) / 2
